choice.basis: The chart visually depicts an overall increase in screening referrals from 2012 to 2023, despite a downward segment in 2022–2023. The title's claim of 'Reduced' is contradicted by the visual data. No routing policy is supplied to resolve the conflict between the title and the line. The only public option justified by the actual chart is the one that aligns with the visual evidence of an overall increase, which is the 'Route to growth-focused referral follow-up'.
